response: Yes, semi-closed endarterectomy of the superficial femoral artery combined with a short venous bypass can be an acceptable alternative for limb-threatening ischemia when there is insufficient venous material. This approach can help restore blood flow to the affected limb, reducing the risk of amputation and improving patient outcomes. However, the decision to use this approach should be made on a case-by-case basis, taking into account the individual patient's anatomy, disease severity, and overall health status.
